_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: T5 Gemeenschappelijke Regeling (GR) consolidation: inter-company posting layer. Adds the IntercompanyTransaction and EliminationRule schemas plus seed objects. The ConsolidationGroup and ConsolidatedReport schemas already live in the monolith from bookkeeping-financial-statements; this fragment adds only the inter-company elimination surface (REQ-ICP-*) on top of that consolidation container.

EliminationRule.title: Elimination Rule
EliminationRule.description: A per-ConsolidationGroup rule declaring which GL account pairs cancel out when inter-company transactions are matched at consolidation time. Rules are metadata; matching itself runs at consolidation time against IntercompanyTransaction records.

consolidationGroupId.description: FK to the ConsolidationGroup this rule applies to.
consolidationGroupId.title: Consolidation Group ID

ruleType.description: auto-match: exact account + amount (within amountTolerance); reference-match: matches on invoice/reference; manual-review: pause and ask an operator before eliminating.
ruleType.title: Rule Type

accountPairFrom.description: GL account code on the selling/providing member (e.g. 4000 Revenue).
accountPairFrom.title: Account Pair From

accountPairTo.description: GL account code on the buying/receiving member (e.g. 7000 Expenses).
accountPairTo.title: Account Pair To

amountTolerance.description: For auto-match: maximum EUR difference allowed between paired amounts. 0 means exact match.
amountTolerance.title: Amount Tolerance

description.description: Free-text note on the rule (e.g. 'Revenue ↔ Expenses inter-company pairs').
description.title: Description

isActive.description: Whether this rule is enforced at consolidation time. Disable instead of deleting to preserve audit history.
isActive.title: Is Active

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create/update/delete of an EliminationRule is logged to OR's immutable audit trail.

IntercompanyTransaction.title: Inter-Company Transaction
IntercompanyTransaction.description: A sale or service between two members of a ConsolidationGroup. Serves as a routing label over the underlying GL posting and as the hook for elimination rules at consolidation time. Elimination happens at consolidation time, not at posting time.

consolidationGroupId.description: FK to the ConsolidationGroup this transaction belongs to.
consolidationGroupId.title: Consolidation Group ID

fromMemberId.description: FK to the selling/providing member Organization.
fromMemberId.title: From Member ID

toMemberId.description: FK to the buying/receiving member Organization.
toMemberId.title: To Member ID

transactionDate.description: Date the service was delivered or sale occurred.
transactionDate.title: Transaction Date

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency; GR members operate in EUR (multi-currency deferred).
currency.title: Currency

accountFrom.description: GL account code on the selling member (e.g. 4000 Revenue).
accountFrom.title: Account From

accountTo.description: GL account code on the buying member (e.g. 7000 Expenses).
accountTo.title: Account To

reference.description: Invoice/PO number or external identifier for manual or reference-match pairing.
reference.title: Reference

description.description: Free-text description of the service or goods.
description.title: Description

glTransactionId.description: FK to the underlying GLTransaction once posted; may be null if the record is created post-facto.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

isManualOverride.description: If true, this transaction is excluded from automatic elimination even if it matches an active rule.
isManualOverride.title: Is Manual Override

overrideReason.description: Operator note recorded when isManualOverride is set or a forced elimination is applied.
overrideReason.title: Override Reason

eliminatedByRuleId.description: FK to the EliminationRule that eliminated this transaction, recorded for audit traceability.
eliminatedByRuleId.title: Eliminated By Rule ID

consolidatedReportId.description: FK to the ConsolidatedReport this transaction was included in once consolidated. Once that report is finalized or published, eliminationStatus is immutable.
consolidatedReportId.title: Consolidated Report ID

eliminationStatus.description: pending: not yet consolidated, included in totals; eliminated: matched a rule and removed from group totals; excluded: manual override, intentionally retained in totals.
eliminationStatus.title: Elimination Status

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Not yet consolidated. Included in consolidated GL totals until matched.

eliminated.label: Eliminated
eliminated.description: Matched an active elimination rule (or forced) and removed from consolidated group totals.

excluded.label: Excluded
excluded.description: Manual override: matches a rule but intentionally retained in consolidated totals at fair-market value.

eliminate.label: Eliminate
eliminate.description: Mark this inter-company transaction as eliminated at consolidation time. Denied once the owning ConsolidatedReport is finalized or published.

exclude.label: Exclude from elimination
exclude.description: Operator override retaining this transaction in consolidated totals. Denied once the owning ConsolidatedReport is finalized or published.

restore.label: Restore to pending
restore.description: Undo an exclusion before the report is finalized so the transaction is reconsidered at the next consolidation run.

reinstate.label: Reinstate
reinstate.description: Reverse an elimination before the report is finalized.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create/update/delete and lifecycle transition (eliminate / exclude / restore / reinstate) of an IntercompanyTransaction is logged to OR's immutable audit trail.

objects.description: Eliminate inter-company revenue (4000) against the matching expense (7000) booked by the receiving member.
Eliminate inter-company receivables (1300) against payables (1600) between group members.
Inter-company loan interest (8100 income ↔ 8200 expense) requires manual review before elimination.
Waste-collection service provided by Gemeente Amsterdam to Gemeente Utrecht.
